visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide shot of a high-ceilinged cafe interior. Patrons are seated at tables in the background. In the foreground, a wooden counter displays various baked breads and pastries. The lighting is warm and bright. (2) A close-up shows a decorative stained glass panel with geometric patterns. Behind the panel, a staff member in a white shirt and black apron is visible working at a counter with a wooden texture. (3) The scene cuts to the exterior of a classical stone building. It features arched windows, decorative cornices, and a main arched entrance. Small green bushes line the sidewalk. (4) A close-up of a white sign above the entrance reads 'BREAD, ESPRESSO & SAKAISUJI CLUB'. (5) A high-angle shot captures the grand interior hall of the building, showing a second-floor balcony with ornate railings and a large vault door in the center background. (6) A closer shot reveals an old, massive metal vault door repurposed as an entrance to another room, with an analog clock mounted above it. (7) A circular display table in the center of the room is covered with green tiles and topped with a large vase of dried flowers and various bread items in baskets. (8) Rapid close-up cuts showcase different pastries: pizza slices with pepperoni, dark canelés on a silver tray, and glazed cinnamon rolls with detailed textures. (9) A white coffee cup and saucer are placed on a blue and white patterned tile tabletop next to a golden-brown croissant and a glazed bagel. (10) A woman with black hair wearing a white knitted sweater takes a bite of the croissant, showing a satisfied facial expression. (11) A pair of hands pulls apart the glazed bagel, revealing its soft, airy inner texture and pistachio filling. (12) The final shot returns to the exterior entrance of the building, showing the stone facade and the entrance sign as text overlays appear.
